- Sort the list ascending; initialize best_pair as first adjacent pair and min_diff as their absolute difference.
- Iterate through sorted numbers comparing each adjacent pair’s difference; if a smaller diff is found, update min_diff and best_pair to that pair (ordered as smaller, larger).
- Return best_pair; assume input length ≥ 2 and floats; stability with equal diffs can prefer the first encountered pair.
